description: This file defines the Cache class for managing SCSS cache operations, including caching, retrieving, and cleaning cache files, with configuration options for cache directory, prefix, and refresh behavior.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Manages caching of SCSS compilation results, including cache retrieval, storage, and cleanup.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes cache settings based on provided options, including cache directory, prefix, and refresh behavior.

methods.name: getCache
methods.description: Retrieves cached data for a specific operation and content if valid and not expired.

methods.name: setCache
methods.description: Stores data in cache for a specific operation and content.

methods.name: cacheName
methods.description: Generates a unique cache filename based on operation, content, and options.

methods.name: checkCacheDir
methods.description: Verifies that the cache directory exists and is writable.

methods.name: cleanCache
methods.description: Removes expired or unused cache files from the cache directory.
